title: Kernel Panic - The Awakening
author: Hocekklocek
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I made this game using partly gemini pro and mostly claude.

The game follows the story of an AI thats trying to take over the network whilst Greg the IT guy is slowly figuring out whats going on and tries to stop it. Its and incremental type of game however I wanted it to feel like it has a lot of story you can follow to make it more interesting.

I feel like I reached the nearly complete stage so please give it a go and let me know what you think.

comments.author: Hocekklocek
comments.body: Note: Im fixing bugs as I find them

replies.author: Hocekklocek
replies.body: Note 2: Trying to balance the game progression is proving to be more difficult than I thought it will be

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body: Fragment amplifier didn't give me the five fragments when I prestiged

replies.author: Hocekklocek
replies.body: I think i need to make the comment for the fragment amplifier clearer, without getting that upgrade you can only earn 15 fragments maximum per prestige, after buying that upgrade the max increase by 5 so you can earn up to 20 fragmenta per prestige etc

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body: As the size of the text for the counters increases and decrease, the execute button shifts up and down kinda annoying.

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body: I wasn't looking and after defeating Greg, it said task a anger is unlocked and I can't dismiss the tip

replies.author: Hocekklocek
replies.body: Thank you so much for all the feedback! I can get onto fixing the bugs right away

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body: Good work man, it occupied me for a while.

replies.author: Hocekklocek
replies.body: Thank you it means a lot, and with your help I fixed the bugs you mentioned and more I found along the way. Its closer and closer to being fully complete

comments.author: KptEmreU
comments.body: Dude awesome. I was semi afk clicking last 10 minutes

comments.author: klipseracer
comments.body: Two prestige, it wasn't clear to me the first time to keep clicking.

replies.author: KptEmreU
replies.body: I am not op but you don't have too. A save or background clicking would be awesome. Wait so do I calculate on my client? Can I hijack and send 1TB RAM 1000 CPU :) Probably.

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body: When the game first starts, it doesn't appear like anything is happening and I didn't know what I was supposed to do. It wasn't until I realized pushing the button more increased a value and then understood this was a clicker game.

replies.author: Hocekklocek
replies.body: I added a tutorial which I thought would help to get you going in the game, could you try doing a hard reset(the red button in the top right corner) and see if tutorial shows up?

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body: Yeah I think I didn't read that tool tip. Then I didn't understand lol

replies.author: Hocekklocek
replies.body: Also I made all this on my phone so not sure if everything appears correctly on a pc if you are using one

replies.author: klipseracer
replies.body:
I'm on a phone, seemed fine. But one hand switching between modes was hard. 

Main suggestion, in the beginning, if the click count on that button is less than like 20, gave that label say (keep clicking!) or something.
